title: Career roadmap · Social Media Analyst
summary: A Social Media Analyst turns platform, audience and campaign data into insights that improve content performance, engagement, reach, conversion and digital marketing decisions.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 3-year B.Sc route, with an optional 4-year honours/research year. Build practical analytics capability alongside marketing knowledge through campaign dashboards, social listening, audience analysis, A/B testing and portfolio projects.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build digital marketing, platform analytics, Excel/SQL, reporting and content-performance skills; target Social Media Analyst, Digital Marketing Analyst, Marketing Analyst or Social Media Executive roles.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in social analytics, paid-media analytics, content intelligence, social listening, influencer analytics or marketing attribution.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Social Media Analyst, Marketing Intelligence Analyst, Growth Analyst, Digital Analytics Consultant or Social Analytics Manager.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine marketing analytics with AI, customer intelligence, experimentation, predictive analytics, first-party data and automated reporting.

blocks.text: PhD routes
Potential research directions include:

The senior Social Media Analyst should evolve from reporting platform metrics into marketing intelligence and decision science. Build expertise in first-party data, experimentation, predictive analytics, AI-assisted insight generation, customer segmentation, attribution and privacy-aware measurement. The strongest professionals will connect social-media behaviour to broader business outcomes rather than focusing only on likes, views and followers.
